about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Developer with client- and server-side experience at leading Russian technology companies. I work on product microfrontends, microservice infrastructure, and customer-facing and internal services. I independently analyze requirements, break down work, and take changes from idea to launch and monitoring. I take ownership of outcomes and can handle tasks beyond my primary stack. I value open communication, constructive feedback, and transparency.

resume.experience.avito.title: Frontend Developer Intern
resume.experience.avito.description: Work on product microfrontends and shared frontend infrastructure. Independently analyze, decompose, and deliver tasks and projects lasting up to two quarters.
resume.experience.avito.details: Designed and implemented the frontend part of the resume package purchase page redesign: coordinated delivery with design, analytics, and backend engineers; after launch, the solution generated RUB 2.4 million in revenue in its first month.

Built from scratch a code review cycle-time analytics system: designed the SQL dataset and queries, launched a Redash dashboard, extended Python code, and configured automated AI notifications; the solution reduced median review time by 2 working hours.
Raised automated test coverage for packages and microfrontends handed over to the team to a healthy 75%; wrote numerous unit and e2e tests, including work outside the core frontend stack.
Launched product changes through successful A/B tests: configured experiment branching, exposure, and ClickStream events.
Removed duplicated code across 2 company verticals: extracted shared functionality into reusable packages and eliminated approximately 2,000 lines of repeated implementation.
Investigated and fixed more than 30 production bugs on Web, mobile web, Android, and iOS; validated primary and error scenarios after releases and monitored the changes.
Mastered the internal BDUI platform and led work on 5 epics based on it; contributed to technical solutions, design reviews, and code reviews, and reviewed colleagues' changes.
resume.experience.yandex.title: Fullstack Developer Intern
resume.experience.yandex.description: Worked on user-facing and internal Yandex Cloud services. During the internship, closed more than 50 product tasks, technical improvements, and production issues.
resume.experience.yandex.details: Delivered end to end a client retention scenario for users leaving Yandex Cloud services: built interfaces and modals for saving contacts and collecting feedback, extended the Node.js and Express API, and prepared database migrations.
Reworked support chat history: replaced pagination with conversation grouping by user sessions, reducing the number of actions required to view history by 19%.
Implemented user onboarding for the Yandex Cloud main page.
Developed the internal back-office application for support employees: delivered numerous improvements and fixed more than 10 production issues.
Participated in user-flow design, design reviews, and code reviews with senior engineers on the team.
